name: typesafe-jev
description: Ask for typed judgments with probabilities instead of parsing prose, through TypeSafe or OpenRouter (Jev: noul, choice, score, box) or Ollama (Clef: noul, choice, score), with the backend chain configured explicitly.

interface.shortDescription: Typed judgments with probabilities, not parsed prose
interface.longDescription: Adds one MCP tool, evaluate, that sends state and typed questions to Jev through TypeSafe or OpenRouter, or to Ollama (Clef), and returns noul, choice, and score answers with probabilities; Jev also supports box. The backend chain is configured explicitly rather than by whichever API key happens to be set. Ships TypeSafe's agent skill, adapted so the tool is used for in-session judgments and the SDK guidance stays for building an application.
defaultPrompt: Use evaluate to classify this ticket and pick the owning team.
Score these candidates against the brief with evaluate.
